research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Vianai Systems, Inc. is focused on enhancing machine learning models and AI solutions. Their work includes simplifying convolutional neural networks for better performance and efficiency, and techniques for automated decision making in workflows using causal inference models. They are also developing methods for dynamic quantization of machine learning inputs and parameters, which could optimize computational resources. Additionally, they are working on container-based software services, logic-based neural networks, and systems for domain-specific question answering models. Their research extends to adaptive visualization of quantized neural networks and frameworks for early warning of domain-specific events. Vianai's R&D efforts are aimed at improving AI interpretability, efficiency, and application in enterprise solutions.

about_short_description.short_description: Vianai provides enterprise artificial intelligence solutions.

product.name: hila Platform
product.description: An enterprise AI platform for querying and analyzing structured and unstructured business data using natural language, with controls for accuracy, model orchestration, monitoring, and secure deployment.

product.name: hila Conversational Finance
product.description: A finance-focused AI application that lets CFO organizations query ERP and other financial data in natural language and receive real-time charts, tables, explanations, and business analysis.

product.name: hila Monitoring
product.description: An AI and LLM operations monitoring solution that tracks model cost, quality, speed, variability, and reliability, with tools for alerts, root-cause analysis, model comparison, and outlier detection.

product.name: Enterprise AI Professional Services
product.description: Consulting, design, implementation, and customization services for deploying reliable conversational AI applications across enterprise data, systems, and business processes.
